newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas Advertising names American to head ad network.
newsitem.headline: Havas Advertising names American to head ad network.

text.p: French advertising and communications group Havas Advertising said on Tuesday it had appointed veteran U.S. industry executive Bob Schmetterer to head its largest ad network.

Schmetterer, who will be chairman and chief executive officer of Euro RSCG, has served for 10 years as one of the managing partners of Havas Advertisting's New York agency MVBMS Euro RSCG which has some $1 billion in billings.
The decision to appoint an American head of the ad network is seen by industry professionals as a groundbreaking move and part of an effort to increase billings originating from U.S. clients.

"This decision gives Euro RSCG an enormous opportunity to become recognised as a leading global network," said a statement from Havas Advertising, which is currently the world's seventh largest agency.
Havas Advertising's chairman Alain de Pouzilhac has stated he aims to make the company among the five leading advertising and communications groups world-wide by the year 2000.
Schmetterer, who will succeed Alain Cayzac as head of the group, will have responsibility for all 163 Euro RSCG companies and the appointment takes effect immediately.
Cayzac will be put in charge of reorganizations and human resources of Havas Advertising.
RSCG was created in 1991 in a merger between two French advertising agencies, Eurocom and RSCG.

Havas Advertising had world-wide client billings in 1995 of 29 billion francs and has a number of big name corporate clients. The holding company's largest shareholder is Havas SA, which controls around 37 percent of the group's equity.
